outcome: Correlation between isthmocele endometriosis and extrauterine endometriosis
cohort: 83 women of reproductive age with symptomatic isthmocele who underwent laparoscopic isthmocele repair at the University of Bern from 2004 to 2020
finding: Endometriosis was a frequent finding in women with symptomatic isthmocele and laparoscopic isthmocele resection was safe and effective in improving symptoms and infertility, regardless of endometriosis presence.
mod_finding: Laparoscopic isthmocele resection was performed using the rendezvous technique and was associated with a 63% pregnancy rate in infertile women, although scar complications during pregnancy were observed in some cases.
